title: Wasteland
build: Electronic Arts disk release, two double-sided disks as four G64 side images; play copies made with the game's own Copy utility

records.c: Tile 0 of tile set 4, blank as in every set: map 24's layer has it on 16 squares, the black left walls of its two pits (x 1-2, y 2-9 and x 6, y 20-21), and map 39's on 46 (a strip down x 16, y 7-22, a block at x 15-17, y 24-28, a patch at x 1-4, y 19-23 and three lone squares); map 39's class-4 square (16, 23) shows it too, and it is the off-map tile of maps 11 and 36. Set 4 serves eight maps of side 3: 11, 24 ('Leaving this scumhole.'), 25, 35, 36 (its texts name 'the Guardians' Citadel'), 39 ('Leaving the hideout.'), 40 ('Leaving the jail.', 'Leaving Fat Freddy's.') and 41 ('Spade's Casino').

Tiles 1-6, the figures every set shares (1 grey robot-like humanoid, 2 red and orange one-eyed hulk, 3 yellow and green runner, 4 man in a cyan shirt, 5 tied sack, 6 brown horned creature); no layer of set 4 holds them. Computed from the records, its encounter squares would show 2 (map 24: 19, 25: 18), 4 (map 35: 14, 36: 18, 39: 8, 40: 9, 41: 31), 1 (map 40: 3) or 6 (map 40: 2), and map 11 has none; tile 5 shows on the loot-bag squares, 2 on map 35, 4 on 36 and 1 on 40.

Tile 7, the green-shirted party figure game $AF1D-$AF25 draws on the party's square. Set 4's layers put it on five squares, but four of them are class 4 and show floor instead (57 at map 36's (29, 21); 58 at map 40's (24, 21) and (6, 23) and map 41's (21, 9)), leaving map 40's (1, 9); map 39's class-4 squares (15, 7), (17, 7) and (16, 30) show 7 over floor 58. The self-modified operand of draw_tile's LDA at $2367 points here because tile 7 was the last drawn.

Tile 8, the radiation sign that draw_square puts on class-9 squares from 18:00 to 05:59 ($0B80-$0B8A). None of set 4's eight maps has a class-9 square or the tile in its layer, so as these maps load it is not drawn with this set.

Tile 9 of set 4, the purple peak over light blue and blue bars that sets 1-3, 5, 7 and 8 have too: game $AD13-$AD49 draws it on the square of each other party of the player's on the same map. No layer of set 4 holds it.

Tiles 10-12 of set 4: 10 a brown chair seen side-on, its back at the right (29 squares: map 11: 5, 35: 14, 39: 1, 41: 9; map 41's class-4 square (22, 11) shows floor 58 over one); 11 orange and white shapes over green specks, set 1's hut 11 in other colours, unused by the maps; 12 a white pole flying a red flag over green specks (map 35 at (11, 24), (17, 24), (22, 24), (9, 26) and (25, 26)).

Tiles 13-21 of set 4, orange blocks with brown edges: 13 and 14 the left and right halves of a block two squares wide (map 40: six pairs in a column at x 11-12, map 41: ten pairs, map 36: a lone 13 at (30, 29)); 15-21 single blocks shaded at the right or bottom, the bitmaps of set 2's 15-21 (15: 12 squares, 16: 10, 17: 25, 18: 15, 19: 22, 20: 17, 21: 18), on every map of the set but 24; map 41's class-4 square (21, 10) shows floor 58 over a 15.

Tile 22 of set 4, a grey ring around a white and black centre on red dashes: twelve class-11 squares in the halls of map 36, six down its west side (x 4-5) and six mirroring them down its east side (x 26-27), at y 3, 6, 9, 14, 17 and 20.

Tiles 23-30 of set 4: 23 and 25 a yellow strip dotted white down the middle of blue (23 under a white line and a black band), in no layer: they are the rope of map 24's class-4 records 3 (23) and 0, 1 and 6 (25), which a rope used on its check squares lays across the sewage stream (remote-change record 0, $3F4B: 23 on the party's square on the north bank, (17-19, 8) or (21-23, 8), and 25 on the two squares south of it) and across the chasm at (7, 20) and (7, 21) (remote-change record 3, $3F71); 24, 28, 26 and 29 the top left, top right, bottom left and bottom right of a blue square framed white, twice on map 39 at (24-25, 11-12) and (24-25, 16-17), and 26 alone on five class-2 squares of map 35; 27 rippled blue water under a white top edge (map 24: 4, 25: 11); 30 blue over a white bottom edge, set 2's 30 (map 24: 6, 25: 2).

Tiles 31 and 32 of set 4: 31 a brown door with a white knob in a dark grey frame (91 squares on all eight maps: 30 class 1, 38 class 2, 18 class 10, the exits, 2 class 11, and 3 class-4 squares of map 41, (0, 5), (1, 7) and (21, 13), which show bricks 90); 32 blank, unused by the maps.

Tiles 33-36 of set 4: 33 white stripes across black, the 16 class-2 squares at the north end of map 36 (x 13-18, y 1-3), where its texts speak of broad marble steps; 34 grey bars between white rails, set 2's 34 (map 41 at (14, 26) and (30, 26), class 10); 35 a brown chair with its back at the left (23 squares: map 11: 6, 35: 7, 41: 10; map 41's class-4 square (20, 11) shows floor 58 over one); 36 brown rungs between brown rails, set 2's 36 (map 39 at (30, 31), map 41 at (5, 13), both class 10).

Tiles 37-40 of set 4: 37 a round orange top on a white stem with a grey base, set 2's 69 in other colours, unused by the maps; 38 black and white checks, the layer tile of map 25's class-4 square (19, 13), which shows bricks 90; 39 and 40 two views of a blue and white shape with red ends, like a vehicle seen from above, unused by the maps.

Tiles 41-45 of set 4: 41 grey and white above a diagonal and black below it, the top left corners of map 24's two pits ((1, 1) and (2, 2); (6, 19)); 42 and 45 blue water flecked light blue (42: 25 squares, 45: 43, on maps 24 and 25, the pits' water among them) and 43 the same under a white top edge (map 24: 2, 25: 12); 44 two white staples, one open below and one above, among red specks, unused by the maps.

Tiles 46-50 of set 4, grey rock with black gaps, the same bytes as sets 1 and 2's 46-50: only 49 is placed, on three class-11 squares at the top left of map 39, (1, 1) to (3, 1); 46-48 and 50 are unused by the maps.

Tiles 51-54 of set 4: 51 a white zigzag lattice, unused by the maps; 52 a blue square outline on red-specked black (15 squares, 14 of them class 2: map 24: 5, 25: 5, 35: 1, 40: 2, 41: 2; map 35's, at (2, 10), is a loot-bag square); 53 scattered grey and white rubble (68 squares, on all eight maps) and 54 a dense heap of it (122 squares on maps 11, 24, 25, 39, 40 and 41, 79 of them class 11), both as in set 2.

Tiles 55-58 of set 4, red dashes on black: 55 with a blue left edge (map 25 at (24, 9) and (5, 18), map 39 at (15, 1)); 56 with a small blue, red and white shape at the bottom (map 25 at (18, 4) and (27, 28)); 57 long dashes in rows (280 squares: map 36: 207, 39: 43, 40: 30); 58 a few scattered dashes, the floor of every map but 36 (2490 squares) and the off-map tile of maps 35, 39, 40 and 41; eleven class-4 squares of maps 24, 39, 40 and 41 show 58.

Tiles 59 and 60 of set 4: 59 a brown and dark grey frame open to the left, set 2's 59 (map 35: 6, among the chairs of its room at x 17-23, y 1-8; map 41 at (25, 28)); 60 a yellow diagonal line over red dashes, the layer tile of map 41's class-4 square (30, 7), which shows floor 58.

Tiles 61-66 of set 4, grey and dark grey walls drawn in perspective: with the corner 41, the black 0 and the water 42, 45 and 92 they make map 24's two square pits seen from above (x 1-7, y 1-10 and x 6-8, y 19-22). 61 the top right corner (3 squares), 62 the right wall (16, and 9 more among the rubble at x 22-30, y 20-30 of map 40), 63 the top wall (9), 64 the bottom right corner (3), 65 the bottom edge (9), 66 the bottom left corner (3).

Tiles 67-69 of set 4: 67 dark grey and white bricks split by a yellow strip, in no layer but the tile of map 24's class-4 record 5 ($3DC3), which remote-change record 3 ($3F71) puts at (7, 19), the top of the rope across the chasm, when a rope is used at (7, 18) or (7, 23); 68 grey and white bricks in uneven courses, the walls of map 11 (211 squares) and map 39 (316), all class 11; 69 a white grid with black holes (81 class-2 squares of map 35, in lines and blocks across its middle).

Tiles 70 and 71 of set 4: 70 a white frame of purple and brown panes, set 2's window 33 in other colours (map 36: 5, at x 4-13, y 29-30; map 40 at (3, 4) and (4, 9); all class 2); 71 a yellow strip down blue, both dotted white, above a white bottom line, in no layer but the tile of map 24's class-4 record 2 ($3DBA), the south end of the rope that remote-change record 0 ($3F4B) lays across the sewage stream, three squares south of the party, when a rope is used on its north bank.

Tiles 72-77 of set 4: 72 a purple panel with its top right cut away in steps, framed dark grey (map 36: 97 squares, all class 11 but one); 73 red and white stripes between red specks (map 35 at (1, 7), map 36 at (21-23, 13), and map 24 at (20, 16), a class-4 square that shows floor 58 instead; map 36's class-4 squares (14-17, 0) show it over floor 87); 74 a brown upright between white and dark grey dashes (map 36: 6, either side of the stripes 33; map 39: 5, at x 22, y 12-16); 75 blue and light blue bands edged grey and white running north-south, set 2's 75, unused by the maps; 76 a purple square beside a purple bar, framed dark grey (map 36: 193, class 11 but two); 77 brown planks laid in alternating directions, unused by the maps.

Tiles 78-83 of set 4: 78, 79, 82 and 83 white bricks with black gaps in broken courses, wall pieces of maps 24, 25, 35 and 40 (78: 78 squares, 79: 73, 82: 41, 83: 57; all class 11 but one); 80 blank, unused by the maps, and 81 a yellow strip dotted white down black, in no layer but the tile of map 24's class-4 record 7 ($3DC9), which remote-change record 3 ($3F71) puts at (7, 22), the south end of the rope across the chasm.

Tiles 84-86 of set 4: 84 a blue box with a white rim, red marks in a window at its top and a lever at its right, like a slot machine (8 squares of map 41, whose texts speak of bells, cherries and lemons spinning: six class 8, two class 3); 85 a green frame around a light blue shape over a red and black checked panel (map 40: 5, all class 8); 86 a figure in purple behind a brown counter, set 1's 10 with brown where that has yellow, unused by the maps.

Tiles 87-89 of set 4: 87 short red dashes in a grid, set 2's floor 61 (237 squares: map 11: 66, 36: 171; four class-4 squares of map 36 show the stripes 73 over it); 88 a purple panel with its bottom left cut away in steps, framed dark grey (map 36: 95, class 11); 89 red dashes staggered like brickwork, set 2's floor 25 (254 squares: map 11: 58, 36: 165, 40: 31).

Tiles 90-95 of set 4: 90 white bricks with black mortar, the walls of all eight maps (2834 squares, all class 11 but two), the off-map tile of maps 24 and 25 and what 21 class-4 squares of maps 25, 39 and 41 show; solid fills 91 green, 92 blue (25 squares among the water of maps 24 and 25), 93 orange, 94 purple and 95 white (every pixel pair 11), all but 92 unused by the maps.

Colour bytes of tiles 0-9 in set 4, one a cell (high nibble: pixel pairs 01, low nibble: pairs 10): the shared figures 0-8 ($26, $CF, $28, $57, $39/$36, $B7/$BC, $98, $59, $76) and $46, $46, $E6, $E6 for tile 9, purple and light blue over blue.

Colour bytes of tiles 10-21 in set 4: $26 (red, blue) then three $96 (brown, blue) for the chair 10; $86, $89, $85 (orange with blue, brown or green) for 11; $52 over $56 (green with red or blue) for the flag 12; $86 and $89 (orange with blue or brown) for the orange blocks 13-21, all $89 in 14.

Colour bytes of tiles 22-36 in set 4: $C2 (grey, red) for the rings 22; $76 (yellow, blue) for the strips 23 and 25; $E6 (light blue, blue) for 24, 27, the bottom cells of 26 and all of 28 but its bottom right cell, which is $26 like 26's top cells; $26 for 29, 30, the blank 32 and the stripes 33; $9B (brown, dark grey) for the door 31 and the rungs 36; $CB for the bars 34; $96, $26, $94, $96 for the chair 35.

Colour bytes of tiles 37-60 in set 4: $82 over $CB (orange, red; grey, dark grey) for 37; $26 for the checks 38 and the shapes 39-40, the outline 52 and the floors 55-58; $CB for the corner 41 (one $26 cell), the rock 46-50 and the rubble 53-54; $E6 for the water 42, 43 and 45 (one $26 cell in 42); $52 for 44; $26 with an $E6 cell for 51; $9B for the frame 59; $26 over $27 (red, yellow) for 60.

Colour bytes of tiles 61-77 in set 4: $CB for the pit walls 61 and 63, $C6 and $CB for 62, $CB with a $2B cell for 64, $26 and $2B (red, blue, dark grey) for 65 and 66; $7B (yellow, dark grey) for 67; $C6 and $CB for the bricks 68; $26 for the grid 69 and the stripes 73; $49 (purple, brown) for the panes 70; $76 for 71; $B4 (dark grey, purple) for the purple walls 72 and 76; $96 and $9B for 74; $6E and $C6 for 75; $96 for the planks 77.

Colour bytes of tiles 78-95 in set 4: $1B (white, dark grey) for the bricks 78, 79, 82 and 83; $26 for the blank 80 and the floors 87 and 89; $7B and $76 for 81; $2E over $6E (red or blue with light blue) for 84; $5E over $52 (green with light blue or red) for 85; $49 for 86; $B4 for 88; $16 (white, blue) for the walls 90; $56 for the green 91, $26 for the blue 92, $86 for the orange 93, $24 for the purple 94 and $26 for the white 95.
